User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Learniverse application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user, sourced from Firebase Auth UID.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Represents a user's subscription plan and associated limits.

currentPeriodEnd.description: The timestamp when the current subscription period ends.

usage.description: Tracks the user's feature usage for the current billing period.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a payment transaction initiated by a user.

orderId.description: The unique order ID from the payment gateway.

userId.description: The UID of the user who initiated the transaction.

planId.description: The ID of the subscription plan being purchased.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

paymentUrl.description: The URL for the user to complete the payment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information, linked to their Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/subscriptions/{subscript.description: Stores the subscription status and usage limits for a specific user. This is a subcollection under each user.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Stores a user's payment transaction history.
